About this offline walkthrough

Everything needed for the interactive invoice-processing demo is inside this HTML file. Share the file, then download and double-click it in a desktop browser—not an email or file-sharing preview.

Using the walkthrough

Start with Guided, with explanations. Show me points to the next control. Fill example and field-level Use example enter editable simulated answers. Saving, consent, activation and downstream handoff always require your explicit action.

Guidance and annotations can be switched independently without losing your progress. Use the EyeTrustAI logo to return to the experience chooser. Returning to the chooser, opening a prepared checkpoint or refreshing starts a new session. Progress is not saved between sessions.

What is simulated

Ledgerline, Meridian Supply BV, the eight invoices, risk scores, completed evidence cohorts and policy results are fictional. This is an interactive product-design demonstration, not an invoice-module validation or a live accounting integration.

The proposed module checks six critical fields in the original extraction against the source invoice. It can permit skipping capture validation, not supplier-authenticity checks, duplicate controls, PO matching, approval, posting or payment. It does not guarantee an individual invoice, detect fraud, or assess tax-law correctness.

Privacy and connectivity

No real supplier or bank details, credentials, uploads, OCR, inference, API calls, emails, support delivery or ERP writes are used. Entries stay in this session; do not enter actual invoice or banking information. The demo makes no network requests. Optional vendor-reference links need internet and open only when you choose to visit them.

This file contains only the invoice-processing walkthrough. The social-listening and clinical walkthroughs remain separate files.
